name: assent-cannot-supersede-a-review
pins: **At `pending_review`, conflicting requires difference.** A run waiting on staff is a queue item as well as a conversation, and superseding it destroys both. "My kid has ear pain" routes with low confidence and queues for review; "looks good. lets book that time" carries the run's own intent, so it classifies as conflicting — and the request a human was about to look at was cancelled, with the patient watching a fresh search start from nothing and never learning why. Difference is decided in code, against the Department table, so a phrasing nobody anticipated cannot slip past a keyword list that does not exist. A genuinely different request still supersedes; withdrawal is always available.

turns.message: book an appointment, my kid has ear pain
looks good. lets book that time
actually I need a dermatology appointment instead
